Tackling multiphysics problems via finite element guided physics-informed operator learning

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Direct Read now simulation_case
Yusuke Yamazaki, Reza Najian Asl, Markus Apel, Mayu Muramatsu, Shahed Rezaei Results in Engineering 2026-07-23 10.1016/j.rineng.2026.112132
单位: Graduate School of Science and Technology, Keio University, Hiyoshi 3–1–1, Kohoku–ku, Yokohama, 223–8522, Japan
通讯: Yusuke Yamazaki @ Graduate School of Science and Technology, Keio University, Hiyoshi 3–1–1, Kohoku–ku, Yokohama, 223–8522, Japan  |  Shahed Rezaei @ ACCESS e.V, Intzestr. 5, 52072, Aachen, Germany
相关性: 该论文提出的有限元引导的物理信息算子学习方法直接解决了多物理场仿真中昂贵采样效率问题，且方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计。
边界: 该论文未涉及植入物或生物力学具体应用，也未包含不确定性量化或实验验证。
动机· 解决多物理场耦合问题中昂贵仿真采样和标签数据依赖的挑战。
方法· 扩展有限元引导的物理信息算子学习，采用加权残差公式，结合多种神经算子架构。
结果· FNO在规则域上精度高，iFOL在复杂不规则几何上高效，并揭示了训练策略的权衡。
验证· 通过非线性热-机械和化学-机械问题及工业铸造案例进行数值验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the high computational cost and label data dependency in multiphysics simulations by developing a finite element-guided operator learning framework.
Method· The proposed method extends finite element-guided physics-informed operator learning to coupled PDEs using a weighted residual formulation, implemented in JAX-based Folax, and evaluates FNO, DeepONet, and iFOL architectures.
Result· FNO achieves high accuracy on regular domains, while iFOL excels on complex irregular geometries, with trade-offs identified between training strategies and network decomposition.
Validation· The approach is validated through numerical simulations of nonlinear thermo-mechanical and chemo-mechanical problems, including 2D/3D microstructures and an industrial casting example.

Curvature modulation of TPMS-based lattices: from geometric design to enhanced mechanical responses

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Ruobing Liao, Zhi Guo, Jichao Liu, Zihong Mai, Xiangyu Ma et al. Figshare 2026-08-04 10.6084/m9.figshare.33157493
相关性: 该论文直接涉及LPBF制造的多孔结构力学性能调控，与您的增材制造生物医学材料方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include stress shielding analysis, stiffness matching to bone, fatigue testing, or osseointegration assessment, which are key for biomedical implant applications.
动机· 突破TPMS结构密度驱动设计瓶颈，实现局部曲率精确调控。
方法· 通过离散几何重构实现Gyroid晶格曲率调制，建立曲率-体积分数模型。
结果· 曲率调制改变失效模式，屈服强度和弹性模量分别提升约33%和29%。
验证· 采用LPBF制备WE43镁合金样品并进行力学测试验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the density-driven design limitation of TPMS lattices and enable precise local curvature customization for enhanced mechanical performance.
Method· A discrete geometric reconstruction approach was proposed to modulate local curvature in Gyroid lattices, and a Curvature-Volume Fraction model was established to correlate curvature with mechanical properties.
Result· Curvature modulation altered failure mode from shear band to layer-by-layer, increasing yield strength by ~33% and elastic modulus by ~29% compared to standard Gyroids.
Validation· Curvature-modulated Gyroid scaffolds were fabricated from WE43 magnesium alloy via laser powder bed fusion and subjected to mechanical testing.

相关性: 该论文直接涉及LPBF制造多孔结构并调控力学性能，与生物医用植入物的刚度匹配和应力遮挡研究高度相关。
边界: This paper does not explicitly link the curvature-modulated lattices to stress shielding or bone-implant interface mechanics, nor does it report fatigue testing or osseointegration properties.
动机· 突破TPMS结构仅依赖密度调控的局限，实现曲率驱动的力学性能定制。
方法· 通过离散几何重构实现Gyroid点阵的局部曲率调控，建立曲率-体积分数模型，并用LPBF制备WE43镁合金样品。
结果· 曲率调控将失效模式从剪切带转为逐层失效，屈服强度和弹性模量分别提升约33%和29%。

Motivation· To overcome the density-driven design paradigm of TPMS lattices by introducing local curvature as a new geometric design dimension for tailored mechanical performance.
Method· A discrete geometric reconstruction method was proposed to modulate local curvature in Gyroid lattices, and a Curvature-Volume Fraction model was established; specimens were fabricated from WE43 magnesium alloy via laser powder bed fusion.
Result· Curvature modulation altered the failure mode from shear band to layer-by-layer, increasing yield strength by ~33% and elastic modulus by ~29% compared to standard Gyroids.
Validation· Mechanical validation was performed via compression testing on LPBF-fabricated WE43 magnesium alloy scaffolds.

Fang He, Xingjie Wang, Jianhua Liu, Hao Gong, Fenqi Xue Physica Scripta 2026-07-23 10.1088/1402-4896/ae8f7c
单位: Beijing Institute of Technology
通讯: Hao Gong @ Beijing Institute of Technology
相关性: 该论文展示了将代理模型与多目标优化结合用于复杂装配过程参数优化的方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的仿真代理与优化。
边界: This paper does not address biomedical implants, biomechanics, or FEA surrogate modeling for implant design; it focuses on optical systems and assembly process optimization.
动机· 提高双反射镜光学系统在服役环境下的成像稳定性。
方法· 建立有限元模型模拟螺栓预紧，结合Zernike拟合与Zemax光学仿真，构建LightGBM代理模型，并用多目标遗传算法优化螺栓扭矩。
结果· 代理模型预测精度超95%，优化后初始与服役后能量集中率分别提升4.37%和11.2%。
验证· 通过仿真案例验证，未涉及实验或临床数据。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enhance the imaging stability of coaxial dual-mirror optical systems under service conditions by optimizing assembly process parameters.
Method· A finite element model of the optical system with threaded structures is built to simulate bolt tightening and coupled-field effects; Zernike polynomials and Zemax optical simulation are integrated to link assembly stress to imaging quality, and a LightGBM-based surrogate model is trained to predict the energy concentration ratio, followed by a Pareto-based multi-objective genetic algorithm to optimize bolt torques.
Result· The surrogate model achieves over 95% prediction accuracy, and the optimized process parameters improve the initial and post-service energy concentration ratios by 4.37% and 11.2% on average, respectively.
Validation· The method is validated through simulation cases only, with no experimental or clinical validation.

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Simon Wiesheier, Miguel Ángel Moreno, Paul Steinmann Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 2026-07-23 10.1016/j.cma.2026.119245
相关性: 该论文提出了一种数据自适应样条超弹性本构模型，其高效校准和不确定性量化能力可迁移至植入物生物力学有限元代理建模。
边界: This paper does not address implant design, bone-implant interface mechanics, or FEA surrogate modeling for biomechanical systems; it focuses on constitutive modeling of hyperelastic materials.
动机· 解决可分离超弹性模型精度受限和全耦合数据驱动方法计算成本高的问题。
方法· 提出在物理可行不变量域上定义双变量B样条曲面，通过均匀变形模式直接校准，转化为约束线性最小二乘问题。
结果· 相比可分离方法精度更高，校准快速且初始化无关，适合重复校准场景。
验证· 通过数值基准测试验证模型精度和校准效率。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the accuracy limitations of separable invariant-based hyperelastic models and the computational cost of fully coupled data-driven approaches.
Method· A bivariate B-spline surface is defined on the physically admissible invariant domain, and calibration is performed directly from homogeneous deformation modes, reducing the problem to a constrained linear least-squares fit.
Result· The proposed model achieves higher accuracy than separable models while maintaining fast, robust, and initialization-independent calibration, making it suitable for repeated calibration tasks.
Validation· The model is validated through numerical benchmarks using homogeneous deformation data, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency.

Motivation· Conventional tibial inserts lack subject-specific customization, leading to premature degradation under varying body weights.

Validation· Experimental validation was performed using an Instron machine under quasi-static and cyclic loading conditions.

边界: 该论文未涉及生物医学植入物、骨力学或应力遮挡，且未包含不确定性量化，仅针对法兰-螺栓-垫片系统的热-结构耦合优化。

方法· 利用循环对称性建立1/12周期有限元模型，结合RSM和Kriging代理模型，采用NSGA-II和TOPSIS进行多目标优化。

Motivation· To enhance the sealing reliability of high-temperature flange-bolt-gasket systems through multi-objective optimization considering coupled leakage, cracking, and yielding constraints.
Method· A 1/12 periodic-sector finite element model with thermal-structural coupling was developed, and response surface and Kriging surrogates were built from central composite designs, followed by Sobol sensitivity analysis and NSGA-II/TOPSIS optimization.
Result· The TOPSIS-selected optimum increased minimum gasket contact pressure by 31.01% and reduced flange stress by 2.26%, achieving coordinated improvement in sealing and structural safety.
Validation· The FE model was validated against the Omiya-Sawa benchmark with errors below 1.5%, and the optimum was verified by ANSYS back-substitution.

动机· 电机设计面临多物理场仿真成本高、优化困难的问题，亟需AI加速。

Motivation· The high computational cost of finite element and multi-physics simulations in electrical machine design motivates the use of AI to accelerate optimization and expand design spaces.

Motivation· Existing parameterized PINNs suffer from inefficient training and poor generalization across parameter domains, motivating a continual-learning approach to improve accuracy and resource efficiency.
Method· The proposed CL-PINN sequentially learns PDE instances at different parameter values, integrating Bayesian-optimization-based active selection, dynamic loss weighting, sparse physics-constrained replay, and an optional parameter subnetwork.
Result· Multi-seed experiments on five benchmarks show that CL-PINN achieves higher and more balanced accuracy than fixed-sampling and grid-greedy baselines while reducing objective-loss queries.
Validation· Validation is performed via numerical benchmarks on a continuous function and four parameterized PDEs, with multi-seed evaluations under prescribed resource protocols.

Motivation· To reduce the high computational cost of generating high-fidelity FEA data for training surrogate models in structural analysis.
Method· A transfer learning framework is proposed that combines abundant low-fidelity data from coarse meshes with a limited set of high-fidelity data from fine meshes to train a neural network surrogate.
Result· The transfer learning approach achieves accuracy comparable to models trained solely on high-fidelity data while substantially cutting computational expense.
Validation· The method is validated on three tow-steered composite case studies with varying numbers of design variables, and key factors affecting transfer learning are systematically investigated.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine whether combining two regional anesthesia techniques improves postoperative analgesia and functional recovery after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A double-blind randomized controlled trial compared a combined pericapsular nerve group (PENG) and suprainguinal fascia iliaca compartment block (SIFICB) against PENG block alone in 60 patients.
Result· The combined block significantly reduced pain scores, prolonged analgesia duration, and decreased rescue analgesic consumption in the first 48 hours postoperatively.
Validation· Clinical validation through a randomized controlled trial with 60 patients, assessing pain scores, analgesic use, and functional outcomes.

Motivation· The paper aims to establish a formal theoretical foundation for future world model architectures that store knowledge in explicit knowledge graphs rather than parametric weights.
Method· It introduces Theorem 9, which analyzes a phase transition in the OD-1 rate condition and proposes a knowledge graph completeness threshold as the new authoritative representation condition.
Result· The theorem demonstrates that the parametric-encoding domain becomes vacuous under world models and prescribes actions identical to OD-2 for the present architecture.
Validation· The framework is formally derived but lacks empirical validation, with testability projected only after large-scale deployment around 2035-2040.
